proof_body:
by
  have hl : 0 < Real.log 10 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have h1 : Real.log ((10 : ℝ) ^ 3) < Real.log ((2 : ℝ) ^ 10) := Real.log_lt_log (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have h2 : Real.log ((2 : ℝ) ^ 3) < Real.log 10 := Real.log_lt_log (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  rw [Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow] at h1
  rw [Real.log_pow] at h2
  push_cast at h1 h2
  constructor
  · rw [lt_div_iff₀ hl]; linarith
  · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hl]; linarith
